messages.confirmEnableAiProfile: This will enable AI capabilities for this account member. Continue?
messages.confirmDisableAiProfile: This will disable AI capabilities for this account member. Continue?
messages.aiProfileEnabled: AI profile has been enabled successfully.
messages.inboxMustBelongToSameAccount: Only inboxes from the same Chat Account can be linked to this Account Membership.

tooltips.chatwootAccountUserId: The account-user membership ID in Chat. This field is automatically populated after sync.
tooltips.chatwootInboxes: The inboxes this account member has access to. Managed automatically by the inbox member sync.
tooltips.isAI: Enable to configure this member as an AI-powered agent.
tooltips.aiPrompt: The system prompt that defines the AI agent's behavior and capabilities.
tooltips.knowledgeBaseCategories: Select knowledge base categories. Articles in these categories (and their sub-categories) will be available for AI-powered responses.
tooltips.calendarsToManage: Select users whose calendars this AI agent can manage. The agent can check availability, create, update, and delete appointments for these calendars. Use the "Internal Notes" column next to each calendar to record per-professional guidance (internal use — never quoted verbatim to the customer).
tooltips.calendarDescription: Internal text (up to ~4000 chars) describing per-professional/location guidance — e.g. service types, age restrictions, prep instructions. Injected into the AI agent's system prompt but NEVER quoted verbatim to the customer.
tooltips.calendarEventType: Which CRM entity type the AI agent should create when booking for this calendar. Appointment is the default; Meeting and Call are also supported.
tooltips.funnelsToManage: Select the opportunity funnels this AI agent can manage. The agent can create, update, and delete opportunities in these funnels. Use the "Internal Notes" column next to each funnel to record per-funnel guidance (internal use — never quoted verbatim to the customer).
tooltips.description: Internal text (up to ~4000 chars) describing per-funnel guidance — e.g. value restrictions, target audience, qualification criteria. Injected into the AI agent's system prompt but NEVER quoted verbatim to the customer.
